<content>
1: // Minimal Orbit Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Game state
12:   const ship = {
13:     angle: 0,            // radians
14:     radius: 150,         // distance from planet centre
15:     speed: 0.02,         // angular speed
16:     thrustPower: -0.5,   // change radius per frame when thrusting
17:     fuel: 100,
18:     radiusSize: 10,
19:   };
20: 
21:   const planet = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, radius: 30 };
22: 
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   const asteroidConfig = {
25:     count: 5,
26:     speed: 1.5,
27:     size: 12,
28:     spawnRadius: Math.max(width, height) / 2 + 20,
29:   };
30: 
31:   // Input handling – space or ArrowUp for thrust
32:   let thrust = false;
33:   // Audio setup
34:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
35:   let thrustOsc = null;
36:   function startThrustSound() {
37:     if (thrustOsc) return;
38:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
39:     thrustOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
40:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
41:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
42:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
43:     thrustOsc.start();
44:   }
45:   function stopThrustSound() {
46:     if (!thrustOsc) return;
47:     thrustOsc.stop();
48:     thrustOsc.disconnect();
49:     thrustOsc = null;
50:   }
51:   function playExplosion() {
52:     const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.2;
53:     const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
54:     const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
55:     for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
56:       data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.pow(1 - i / bufferSize, 2);
57:     }
58:     const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
59:     noise.buffer = buffer;
60:     const filter = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
61:     filter.type = 'lowpass';
62:     filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1000, audioCtx.currentTime);
63:     noise.connect(filter).connect(audioCtx.destination);
64:     noise.start();
65:   }
66:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') { thrust = true; startThrustSound(); audioCtx.resume(); } });
67:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') { thrust = false; stopThrustSound(); } });
68: 
69:   function spawnAsteroid() {
70:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
71:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * asteroidConfig.spawnRadius;
72:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * asteroidConfig.spawnRadius;
73:     const vx = (planet.x - x) / asteroidConfig.spawnRadius * asteroidConfig.speed;
74:     const vy = (planet.y - y) / asteroidConfig.spawnRadius * asteroidConfig.speed;
75:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: asteroidConfig.size });
76:   }
77: 
78:   // Initialize asteroids
79:   for (let i = 0; i < asteroidConfig.count; i++) spawnAsteroid();
80: 
81:   function update(dt) {
82:     // Update ship orbit
83:     ship.angle += ship.speed;
84:     if (thrust && ship.fuel > 0) {
85:       ship.radius += ship.thrustPower * dt;
86:       ship.fuel -= 0.05 * dt;
87:     }
88:     // Prevent radius from going inside planet or off canvas
89:     ship.radius = Math.max(planet.radius + ship.radiusSize, Math.min(ship.radius, Math.min(width, height) / 2 - ship.radiusSize));
90: 
91:     // Update asteroids
92:     for (const a of asteroids) {
93:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
94:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
95:     }
96:     // Re‑spawn any asteroid that passed the planet
97:     for (let i = 0; i < asteroids.length; i++) {
98:       const a = asteroids[i];
99:       const dx = a.x - planet.x;
100:       const dy = a.y - planet.y;
101:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < planet.radius) {
102:         // collision with planet – remove and spawn new
103:         asteroids.splice(i, 1, null);
104:         spawnAsteroid();
105:         i--;
106:       }
107:     }
108:   }
109: 
110:   function draw() {
111:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
112: 
113:     // Background stars
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
115:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
116:     // draw simple starfield
117:     for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
118:       const sx = Math.random() * width;
119:       const sy = Math.random() * height;
120:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5) + ')';
121:       ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, 1, 1);
122:     }
123:     // Planet with gradient
124:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius * 0.2, planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius);
125:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#98fb98');
126:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#2e8b57');
127:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
128:     ctx.beginPath();
129:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
130:     ctx.fill();
131: 
132:     // Ship (triangle)
133:     const shipX = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
134:     const shipY = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
135:     const shipDir = ship.angle;
136:     const size = ship.radiusSize;
137:     ctx.fillStyle = '#1e90ff';
138:     ctx.beginPath();
139:     ctx.moveTo(
140:       shipX + Math.cos(shipDir) * size,
141:       shipY + Math.sin(shipDir) * size
142:     );
143:     ctx.lineTo(
144:       shipX + Math.cos(shipDir + Math.PI * 0.75) * size * 0.6,
145:       shipY + Math.sin(shipDir + Math.PI * 0.75) * size * 0.6
146:     );
147:     ctx.lineTo(
148:       shipX + Math.cos(shipDir - Math.PI * 0.75) * size * 0.6,
149:       shipY + Math.sin(shipDir - Math.PI * 0.75) * size * 0.6
150:     );
151:     ctx.closePath();
152:     ctx.fill();
153:     // Thrust flame
154:     if (thrust && ship.fuel > 0) {
155:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
156:       ctx.beginPath();
157:       ctx.moveTo(
158:         shipX - Math.cos(shipDir) * size * 0.8,
159:         shipY - Math.sin(shipDir) * size * 0.8
160:       );
161:       ctx.lineTo(
162:         shipX + Math.cos(shipDir + Math.PI * 0.5) * size * 0.4,
163:         shipY + Math.sin(shipDir + Math.PI * 0.5) * size * 0.4
164:       );
165:       ctx.lineTo(
166:         shipX + Math.cos(shipDir - Math.PI * 0.5) * size * 0.4,
167:         shipY + Math.sin(shipDir - Math.PI * 0.5) * size * 0.4
168:       );
169:       ctx.closePath();
170:       ctx.fill();
171:     }
172: 
173:     // Asteroids with gradient shading
174:     for (const a of asteroids) {
175:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
176:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#d2691e');
177:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#8b4513');
178:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
179:       ctx.beginPath();
180:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
181:       ctx.fill();
182:     }
183: 
184:     // Fuel bar
185:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
186:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, 100, 10);
187:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
188:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, ship.fuel, 10);
189:   }
190: 
191:   function checkCollision() {
192:     const shipX = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
193:     const shipY = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius;
194:     for (const a of asteroids) {
195:       const dx = a.x - shipX;
196:       const dy = a.y - shipY;
197:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.radius + ship.radiusSize) {
198:         return true;
199:       }
200:     }
201:     return false;
202:   }
203: 
204:   let last = performance.now();
205:   let gameOver = false;
206:   function loop(now) {
207:     const dt = (now - last) / 16; // normalise to ~60fps units
208:     last = now;
209:     if (!gameOver) {
210:       update(dt);
211:       draw();
212:       if (ship.fuel <= 0 || checkCollision()) {
213:         gameOver = true;
214:         playExplosion();
215:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
216:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
217:         ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
218:         ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
219:         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
220:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
221:       } else {
222:         requestAnimationFrame(loop);
223:       }
224:     }
225:   }
226: 
227:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
228: })();

(End of file - total 228 lines)
</content>
